text: dsh-vision-fallback-bridge 是面向 DSH Web 的上传桥接插件，为文本型模型提供图片和常见文档的工作区路径。它在 DSH 主机注册精确导入路由，并在浏览器侧接入文件拖放、粘贴和会话发送流程；图片可保留原生附件处理，文档会排队显示为可移除标签，发送时上传并把带类型标记的路径加入消息。适合希望通过文件工具或视觉工具处理附件的 Web 用户。文件写入当前会话工作区的 .dsh-vision/uploads；使用时需能读取 DSH 工作区注册信息，也可从会话取得工作区路径。

dsh-vision-fallback-bridge lets DSH Web send attachments to text-only models as workspace paths. It registers a host upload route and handles browser drops, pastes, and sends. Images and common documents upload on send; type-labelled paths reach vision or file tools. Files go in workspace.
想把图片作为工作区文件路径发给文本型模型处理。
在网页聊天里拖入 PDF 或表格后，希望模型能收到可用的文件路径。
How can I pass pasted documents to a text-only chat model as workspace files?
dsh-vision-fallback-bridge 的功能「附件转工作区路径」：在 Web 聊天中拖放或粘贴支持的图片、文档，发送消息时上传到当前工作区，并将带图片或文件类型标记的路径附加到消息中。

@dsh-external/dsh-vision-fallback-bridge README · dsh-vision-fallback-bridge：Lightweight DSH upload bridge for text-only DeepSeek models.

- Images keep the native DSH attachment UI and are converted to workspace paths on send.
- Common documents (pdf/docx/xlsx/pptx/txt/md/csv/json/zip) are queued as simple chips and converted to workspace paths on send.
- The model receives type-labelled paths, so it can route images to Qwen-MM-Plugins vision tools and documents to file tools.

@dsh-external/dsh-vision-fallback-bridge README · Install：Copy this directory into `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@dsh-external/dsh-vision-fallback-bridge`, then add `@dsh-external/dsh-vision-fallback-bridge` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`.

Restart DSH Web profile.

@dsh-external/dsh-vision-fallback-bridge README · Storage：Uploaded files are written to:

```text
<workspace>/.dsh-vision/uploads/
```

@dsh-external/dsh-vision-fallback-bridge README · Supported types：| Type | Extensions |
|---|---|
| Images | png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif |
| Documents | pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, ppt, pptx, txt, md, csv, json, zip |
